_comment: 森林以后的物品（flight1 / river / final 三段剧本草稿用；10-30 按合订稿 yun1.txt 更新描述）。格式同 items.json；森林已有物品沿用 items.json 的 id，不在这里重复。category = material / keepsake / quest；纪念品 keepsake_burn = 以后飞行段烧掉给的燃料，burn_note = 烧掉时晨的一句话。added = 描述是补写的。

desc.en: The hand-drawn seat map from the commuter card's sleeve. Besides the sunny seats, it notes "The third car's doors slam." One seat was scribbled out, then circled again. They picked that seat together. Waiting for the afternoon sun, they missed their stop, and the friend said next time they'd have to time it right.
desc.zh: 从通勤卡的卡套里抽出来的手绘座位图。除了能晒到太阳的位置，还写着「第三节车厢的门关得很响」。有一处座位被涂掉，又重新圈了回来。那处座位是两个人一起挑的，为了等下午的太阳，坐过了站，朋友还说下次得算准时间。

desc.en: Niff's South Bridge footage of the elephant; the new label says: "When you find it, come back and tell me."
desc.zh: 妮芙拍到大象的南桥影像，新标签写着：「找到了，记得回来告诉我。」

burn_note.zh: 晨合上盒盖时，会用手指把翘起来的标签角压平，再放进装置。
burn_note.en: Chen closes the lid, presses the curling corner of the label flat, then puts it in the converter.

desc.en: The copper bell from Niff's little boat; the tag says "Given to Chen. No need to return."
desc.zh: 原本挂在妮芙小船上的铜铃，标签写着「已经送给晨，不用还」。

burn_note.zh: 转化以后，系铃的绳圈仍挂在那里，机身晃动时轻轻摆动。
burn_note.en: Once it's converted, the loop of string it hung from stays behind, swaying when the ship rocks.

desc.en: A bottle of river water labeled "The river Chen visited"; Niff tested it upside down, and it doesn't leak.
desc.zh: 一瓶河水，标签写着「晨来过的那条河」，妮芙倒过来试过，不漏。

burn_note.zh: 空瓶上仍贴着「晨来过的那条河」的标签。
burn_note.en: The empty bottle still has its label: "The river Chen visited."

name.en: The Life of Miss Niff (Chapter One)

desc.en: A notebook from Niff; page one reads "Chapter One: Miss Niff Drops a Crate," and the rest is waiting for Chen to write it.
desc.zh: 妮芙送的本子，第一页写着「第一章：妮芙小姐掉了一箱东西」，后面等晨来写。

desc.en: A rubbing of the big footprint from the South Bridge mudflat, about the size of the forest sketch.
desc.zh: 南桥泥滩上拓下来的大脚印，和森林里的速写差不多大。

desc.en: A tracing of the cup's mark, with the date Milo's friend left and the ship's name on the back, for Milo.
desc.zh: 杯底记号的描图，背面抄着弥洛的朋友离开的日期和船名，要带给弥洛。

desc.en: Old dock photo: the elephant with the notched left ear being coaxed up a ramp, the boat number on the back.
desc.zh: 货台旧照片：左耳缺一角的大象正被引上坡板，背面写着船号。

desc.en: Not-too-sweet biscuits from the upper market; keep them away from the oil can.
desc.zh: 高处市集买的不太甜的饼干，别靠着油壶。

desc.en: An old-model reading head from the equipment cabinet in the underwater warehouse.
desc.zh: 从水下仓库设备柜里找到的旧型号读取头。

desc.en: The sluice gate log from the underwater warehouse; Niff signed the last opening.
desc.zh: 水下仓库的泄水门记录，最后一次开闸的签名是妮芙。

desc.en: Niff's waterproof board, with both their names, what they came for, and "Follow the guide rope."
desc.zh: 妮芙的防水板，写着两人的名字、来取什么和「跟着导绳走」。

desc.en: An air tank and mask borrowed from the upper market; Niff wrote down where to return them.
desc.zh: 高处市集借的气瓶和面罩，妮芙写好了归还地点。

desc.en: An old pipe joint fished out of the river, for fixing the ship.
desc.zh: 从河里捞上来的旧管道接头，修飞机用。

desc.en: A float seal from the underwater warehouse, for fixing the ship.
desc.zh: 水下仓库里找到的浮筒密封圈，修飞机用。

desc.en: A bag of dried driftwood from Ting, good for burning.
desc.zh: 阿汀送的一袋晾干的浮木，可以烧。

desc.en: The first page, torn from the journal and folded, kept inside the coat with the original drawing. It still says only: "I have to find the elephant, because" and then a lot of blank space. Kept through every item choice and all four endings. Not fuel. View only.
desc.zh: 从日记上拆下来的第一页，折好了，和最初那张画一起放在外套内侧。纸上仍只写着：“我一定要找到大象，因为”，后面留着大片空白。所有物品选择和四个结局里都保留，不计入燃料，只能查看。

desc.en: A few sheets borrowed from the locals after the journal burned. Today goes on these for now.
desc.zh: 日记烧掉以后，向居民借来的几张纸。今天的事先记在这上面。

desc.en: A flask of soup from Mama Rat, for when it gets cold on the road.
desc.zh: 鼠妈灌的一壶汤，路上冷了就喝。

desc.en: A recipe for river shrimp soup; the last line says "Low heat. Let it come to a boil on its own."
desc.zh: 一锅河虾汤的做法，最后一行写着「火别太大，等它自己滚」。

desc.en: Three rice balls from Mama Rat; eat one today.
desc.zh: 鼠妈包的三个饭团，一个今天吃。
